sources.title: PDF Generative Zero-Shot Composed Image Retrieval - CVF Open Access
sources.snippet: Abstract Composed Image Retrieval (CIR) is a vision-language task utilizing queries comprising images and textual descrip-tions to achieve precise image retrieval. This task seeks to find images that are visually similar to a reference im-age while incorporating specific changes or features de-scribed textually (visual delta).

sources.title: CVPR 2026 Open Access Repository
sources.snippet: Abstract Text-to-image retrieval, powered by pre-trained vision-language models such as CLIP, typically represents user intent as a single fixed-dimensional query embedding. This approach, however, struggles when queries are short, ambiguous, or underspecified, as it fails to capture the full range of desired visual attributes.

sources.title: Llama Nemoretriever Colembed: Top-Performing Text-Image Retrieval Model
sources.snippet: Motivated by the growing demand for retrieval systems that operate across modalities, we introduce llama-nemoretriever-colembed, a unified text-image retrieval model that delivers state-of-the-art performance across multiple benchmarks. We release two model variants, 1B and 3B.
